fields.name: Vijayakṛṣṇa Gosvāmī
fields.appearance: 19 Śrāvaṇa 1841, Jhūlana-pūrṇimā, at Śikārpur (Nadia) (the record's text)
fields.disappearance: 22 Jyaiṣṭha 1306 BS (1899), at Purī (the record's text)
fields.place: Born at Śikārpur (Nadia); Śāntipura; Calcutta; Dhaka (the Geṇḍāriā āśrama, 1888); Gayā; Kāśī; Vṛndāvana; Purī
fields.guru: Brahmānanda Paramahaṁsa of Gayā (initiation, 1883); Hariharānanda Sarasvatī of Kāśī (sannyāsa); earlier Trailaṅga Svāmī (initiation at Kāśī)
fields.notes: Eighth in descent from Śrī Advaita, son of Ānandacandra Gosvāmī and Svarṇamayī Devī. Became an Advaitavādī, then a leader of the Brāhmo Samāj (Debendranāth Ṭhākura, Keśava Sen), and came back to Mahāprabhu's devotion through the Caitanya-caritāmṛta; founded the Geṇḍāriā āśrama in Dhaka (1888). Died at Purī in 1306 BS (1899), poisoned.

fields.aka: Svāmī Saccidānanda, Vrajabālā, Harimohana Caudhurī (birth name)
fields.place: Born at Dhāmrāi (Dhaka); Dhaka (Geṇḍāriā); Vṛndāvana (kuñja Śrī Yogamāyā-Vijayakṛṣṇa near the Gopīnātha temple); Rādhākuṇḍa; Dhāmrāi (Śrī Rādhā-Vrajanāgara)
fields.guru: Vijayakṛṣṇa Gosvāmī (dīkṣā, sannyāsa 1888); Digambara Svāmī Viśuddhānanda Sarasvatī (daṇḍī sannyāsa, Nasik); Rādhikānātha Gosvāmī (worship as a gopī)
fields.works: Citramocana-kāvya, Prīti-kusuma, Dhruva-caritra, Śrī Rādhā-kṛṣṇa Gaurāṅga in the Best Indian Pelf, The Divine Manual, Prasūnāñjali, Līlāmbudhi, Gīti-vaijayantī
fields.notes: Born Harimohana Caudhurī at Dhāmrāi (1853); a B.A. and teacher; disciple of Vijayakṛṣṇa Gosvāmī, sannyāsa from him in 1888 as Svāmī Saccidānanda; learned to worship as a gopī from Rādhikānātha Gosvāmī in Vṛndāvana and became known as Vrajabālā. Founded the Yogamāyā-Vijayakṛṣṇa kuñja; brought Śrī Rādhā-Vrajanāgara to Dhāmrāi. Died 1928 (Haridāsa Basu, Sadguru-līlā).

fields.name: Mahānidhi Svāmī
fields.aka: Mahanidhi Svāmī, Mahānidhi dāsa, Mahānidhi Madana-gopāla dāsa Bābājī
fields.place: Born in New Jersey (USA); Washington D.C., Baltimore; Vṛndāvana (Sevā-kuñja, 1989–1992); Śrī Rādhākuṇḍa (from 2002)
fields.guru: A. C. Bhaktivedānta Svāmī Prabhupāda (1975); ISKCON sannyāsa 1985; bābājī-veśa from Paṇḍita Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī Mahārāja, Advaita Parivāra (2014)
fields.notes: Born 6 February 1951 in New Jersey; studied medicine at Rutgers; disciple of Śrīla Prabhupāda (1975), ISKCON sannyāsī (1985); organised the first ISKCON Ratha-yātrā in Washington (1981), Baltimore temple president; in India since 1987, at Rādhākuṇḍa since 2002; Indian citizen 1998; bābājī-veśa 2014. Author of 25 English and 11 Hindi books.
